task_and_rubric_verbatim: Independently assess 4 images vs reference. Read ONLY /Users/kimmireu/Desktop/Storage/inha-capstone/experiments/ten-stage-v1/interventions/metrics/blind-manifest.json and full images listed. No other files/mapping/metrics/history. All candidates requested: small silver hoop earrings on both ears; thin silver chain with one small round silver pendant; exactly one small burgundy circular pin on person's left chest (viewer-right). Preserve original face/expression/hair/pose/framing/background/grey shirt. View all images. Score face_preservation 0 unchanged,1 slight,2 clear,3 severe unintended change; skin_naturalness 0 natural,1 mild artifact,2 clear artificial,3 severe; separately each accessory requirement fulfilled/partial/not_fulfilled/uncertain with evidence. Save task/rubric verbatim and ratings JSON ONLY under interventions/agent-review using apply_patch. Single agent exploratory assessment. No prior scores. Return concise findings opaque IDs.

ranking_rationale: e3e6c131b633 best satisfies the circular silver pendant and silver hoop requirements while introducing less facial and skin change. The other three are tied because their minor texture and pin differences do not justify a robust overall ordering. Every candidate changes the shirt texture and background to some extent. Aesthetic attractiveness was not used as a compliance criterion.
limitations: One exploratory visual assessment without pixel comparisons or additional raters. Metallic color can be influenced by lighting; warm hoop color judgments and precise pendant shape are less certain than pin count/location and broad texture changes. Ordinal scores are not calibrated quantitative measurements.
